item.description:
### A simpler, more reliable sign-in
Signing in, subscribing and managing children now open as an ordinary tab in your default browser, already signed in to your Kahf ID — instead of a separate window that was easy to lose behind everything else.
The whole flow is more robust: one shared session across sign-in, subscriptions and parental controls, and a clear way back if you close the page part-way through.
